main_text.p: incremento, φῶ, φῇς, φῇ, &c. vel ῶ, ῆς, ῆ: unde illa, ῶ δ' ἐγώ, inquam autem ego: ῆ δ' ὸς, inquit autem ille.
Fut. 1. φήσω, φήσεις, &c. Dorice φασῶ, φασεῖς, &c.
Aor. 1. ἔφηα, ἔφησας, &c. Aorist. 2 ἔφλω, ἔφης, &c. 3 plur. ἔφαν & φαί.
Infinit. φαῖαι penacutum: nam φαῖαι per ā, est aor. 1 á φαίνω oftendo, vel appareo.
Futur. s med. φάω, Ionice pro φάσω, dic.
Particip. φάμενος, comp. ἀπαφάμενος, malesuadens, poet. παράφαμενος. 8. φθήμι praevenio, à φθάω: Aorist. 2 ἔφθην.

page.notes: Polytonic Greek is transcribed approximately; accents and breathings in several words are doubtful. Heavy show-through and faded ink near the middle of the page.
